info.title: retry
info.description: Run a command with automatic retries, configurable backoff, and exit-code filtering.

options.name: --jitter
options.description: Add random jitter to delay (50-100% of calculated value)

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write summary to stdout instead of stderr (errors still go to stderr)

options.name: --times
options.description: Max retry attempts, not counting initial run (default: 3)

options.name: --backoff
options.description: Backoff strategy: fixed, linear, exp (default: fixed)

options.name: --on
options.description: Retry only on these exit codes (comma-separated)

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description: Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
